why: Exactly the state the HUD was in before #321: the selection ring is drawn and nothing is announced, so which choice is current is carried by a white border and by nothing else. `setSelected` exists to make the two channels inseparable, and this mutation separates them again by writing the state to a `data-` attribute instead: the value is still recorded, still moves with the choice, and is still invisible to every assistive technology. The class toggle is untouched, so every visual assertion in the suite stays green. Killed by three unit cases in ui.test.ts and by the two HUD sweeps over all 50 choice controls. COUNT MOVED 5 -> 7 for issue #281: the per-slot TEAM buttons are choice controls built with `setSelected`, so the two cases that read their `aria-pressed` -- the untouched slot showing its EFFECTIVE team, and a chosen team surviving a round trip through FFA -- detect this defect as well. Re-measured on the tree, not predicted; the harness reported the mismatch and the declaration was corrected to what it actually trips.
